scope: Actual game + Chromium DOM and keyboard/storage; navigator.getGamepads explicitly simulated, no physical device validation

checks.name: Production controller initialization is exposed
Held confirm on nonzero-slot connection does not enter a menu
Gamepad navigation focuses an actual visible menu button
Focused menu confirmation runs a real UI action
Physical keyboard state is present before gamepad input
Gamepad disconnect preserves a held physical keyboard key
Right stick changes the actual player view with finite pitch
RT fires the actual equipped weapon once on its edge
Select opens the real Pip-Boy
Pip-Boy shoulder navigation changes its real tab
Pip-Boy trigger navigation changes its real subtab without firing
Held trigger across closing a menu does not fire into the world
Start opens actual pause and release does not resume it
Gamepad adjusts real range control and persists preferences
Gamepad toggles a real checkbox and updates settings
B closes options through the real options callback
B resumes through the real pause callback
V.A.T.S. A reserves a real target/limb shot
V.A.T.S. directional selection changes the queued limb
V.A.T.S. X removes the final reserved shot
V.A.T.S. RT executes the actual reserved shot
Field services receive real controller focus
B closes field services with their own callback
Career panel receives real controller focus
B closes career to the recorded previous mode
Controller adjusts actual lockpick angle input
B exits the real lockpicking activity
Controller adjusts the actual pétanque angle
B exits the real pétanque activity
Terminal controls receive real controller focus
B exits the terminal with its own callback
B exits the actual holotape player
No JavaScript exceptions during controller integration
